# README.md

eetf
====


A Rust implementation of [Erlang External Term Format](http://erlang.org/doc/apps/erts/erl_ext_dist.html).

Documentation
-------------

See [RustDoc Documentation](https://docs.rs/eetf).

The documentation includes some examples.
